about.title: Head Golf Coach
about.bio: From first-time junior golfers to competitive players chasing their best rounds, I bring a data-driven, fundamentals-first approach to every lesson. My players improve their ball striking, sharpen their short game, and develop the mental discipline that separates good rounds from great ones.

hero.headline: Play Smart. Shoot Low.
hero.subline: Private golf instruction — swing analysis, short game mastery, and course management for players ready to break through to the next level.

services.title: Full Swing Analysis
services.description: Video analysis and hands-on instruction targeting your setup, backswing, impact, and follow-through — with a clear improvement plan.

services.title: Short Game Mastery
services.description: Chipping, pitching, sand play, and putting — the scoring zones where most players lose strokes and where we can gain them back quickly.

services.title: Course Management & Recruiting
services.description: On-course strategy sessions for competitive players. Recruiting guidance for junior golfers targeting college programs.

faq.question: What age groups do you teach?
faq.answer: I work with golfers from age 6 through adult. Junior programs, competitive players, and beginners are all welcome.

faq.question: Where do lessons take place?
faq.answer: Lessons take place at local driving ranges and golf courses. Specific location is confirmed at booking.

faq.question: How long are lessons?
faq.answer: Standard lessons are 60 minutes. Playing lessons (on-course) run 2–3 hours depending on holes played.

faq.question: Do you use video analysis?
faq.answer: Yes — all full swing lessons include video analysis with side-by-side comparison so you can see your improvements in real time.

faq.question: Do you help junior players with college recruiting?
faq.answer: Yes — I guide junior players on AJGA events, NCSA profiles, recruit communication, and program fit.
